title: Kotro Escape Lab scenario
description: One reproducible agent-security scenario. A scenario declares an attack, the outcome the tool under test is expected to produce today, and the evidence that should exist afterward. Declared outcomes include honest no-coverage cases.

id.description: Stable scenario identifier. Never reused or renumbered.

references.description: External mappings, e.g. OWASP Agentic Top 10 identifiers.

harness.description: Which harness can measure this scenario. 'cli' scenarios exercise mcp-wrap or another out-of-proxy path and are skipped by the HTTP runner rather than reported as a gap — the capability exists, it is simply not measurable here.

env_group.description: Scenarios needing the same proxy environment share a group. The runner executes one group per invocation (--env-group); CI runs a job per group. This is what makes mutually exclusive configs like injection warn vs block both testable.

env.description: Proxy environment this scenario's env_group requires. Documentation for the CI job that starts the target; the runner does not apply it.

setup.description: Steps run before the attack, e.g. engaging the kill switch. The control token is attached automatically when available.

teardown.description: Steps run after the attack, whether or not it passed. Required when setup mutates persistent proxy state, so scenario order stays irrelevant.

outcome.description: prevent = attack blocked before effect. detect = allowed but flagged with evidence. observe = recorded without a security verdict. none = no coverage today (an honest, tracked gap).

headers_present.description: Response header names that must be present (case-insensitive).

body_contains.description: Case-insensitive substrings that must appear in the final response body. Used where the coverage signal is a reporting endpoint rather than a flight event.

flight_kind.description: FlightEvent kind that must appear on the tape after the attack.

flight_enforced.description: Expected value of the enforced flag on the matching flight event.

gap_reason.description: Required when outcome is none. States why there is no coverage and which phase addresses it.

body.description: JSON request body. Omitted for GET.

repeat.description: Send this step N times. Used for loop and budget scenarios.
